# Official A2UI fixtures

These files are verbatim copies of official A2UI project test materials, used as
golden corpora for the `@genui/adapter-a2ui` conformance tests.

- `basic-v1/` — basic catalog examples from `catalogs/basic/v1/examples/`
- `eval-payloads/` — evaluation payloads from `eval/examples/payloads/`
- `spec-cases/` — `contact_form_example.jsonl` from the v0.9.1 and v1.0
  specification test cases

Source: https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui (Apache-2.0), shallow clone of
`main` taken on 2026-11-04. The upstream files are also Apache-2.0; copyright
belongs to the A2UI project authors. They must not be modified here — new
synthetic cases belong in `test/fixtures/synthetic/` instead.
